name: mutation-tap
description: /mutate runs a mutation test limited to the lines changed since HEAD: each small change to the code (a flipped comparison, && for ||, a constant) is run against the tests, and the ones the tests did not catch are listed

maxMutants.title: Max mutants
maxMutants.description: How many mutants one /mutate runs at most, spread over the changed lines

timeoutSec.title: Test timeout (s)
timeoutSec.description: Seconds one test run may take before it is stopped; a mutant that runs past it counts as caught (timeout)

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: The command that runs the tests, from the repository root; empty to guess it from the project (package.json, Makefile, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml, Package.swift)
